water-eg-760mmHg.citation: Vapor-liquid equilibrium table for ethylene glycol/water at 760 mmHg, Wikipedia 'Ethylene glycol (data page)', compiled from the literature
water-eg-760mmHg.access: Open (CC BY-SA text; the numbers are compiled experimental data).
water-eg-760mmHg.note: Secondary compilation with visible scatter. To be replaced by an open primary source, e.g. Kamihama et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 339, whose data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive.

schmid2007.citation: B. Schmid, M. Döker, J. Gmehling, Measurement of the thermodynamic properties for the reactive system ethylene glycol–acetic acid, Fluid Phase Equilibria 258 (2007) 115–124
schmid2007.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).

kamihama2012.citation: N. Kamihama, H. Matsuda, K. Kurihara, K. Tochigi, S. Oba, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for Ethanol + Water + Ethylene Glycol and Its Constituent Three Binary Systems, J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 339-344
kamihama2012.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
kamihama2012.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 4 (boiling temperature) and 5 (vapour mole fraction): the binary ethanol + water set. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).
